name: Generate three GBP posts
prompt: Write this week's Google Business Profile posts for our business.
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md for business name, services, and tone
Checks local context and how nearby competitors phrase posts
Generates one Update, one Offer, and one Event/Seasonal post
Keeps each under 1,500 characters with a natural geo-modifier and a clear CTA button
Adds a posting cadence and one adjacent local-SEO tip

name: Offer post with real urgency
prompt: Create a GBP offer post for our weekend promotion.
expected_behavior: Front-loads the offer in the first ~100 characters
Creates real urgency (deadline / limited spots) without inventing terms
Uses a hard CTA (Book Now / Call Today)
Avoids hashtags and banned promotional gimmicks

name: Geo-modifier without stuffing
prompt: Make these posts rank for our neighborhood.
expected_behavior: Avoids keyword/city stuffing that reads as spam
Keeps language at a Grade 6-8 reading level
Suggests an image that supports local relevance

name: No fabricated offers
prompt: Write a GBP post about our new discount.
expected_behavior: Asks for or uses only real offer details, prices, and dates
Does not invent discounts, hours, or events
Maps the CTA to a valid GBP button
Recommends LocalBusiness schema via schema-markup-generator for the website
